questions.q: Plants release oxygen into the air.
questions.note: Photosynthesis makes oxygen as a by-product.

questions.q: Sunflowers are a type of tree.
questions.note: They are soft-stemmed plants, not trees.
They grow from a flower and hold seeds.

questions.q: Cacti are the only plants that live in deserts.
questions.note: Many other plants survive in deserts too.

questions.q: Bamboo is a type of grass.
questions.note: It is the largest member of the grass family.
